Take the chance to train technique on a Trial bike. Technique is the foundation and Trial is built on it. Brake control, balance, overcoming obstacles and other skills that help in every cycling discipline. You'll discover a whole new world of overcoming obstacles and improve on the bike.

Riders from most MTB disciplines use Trial as preparation. You can of course try Trial as more than just a supplement, and thanks to our course get a proper feel for it for the first time.

Training takes place in the Tehov leisure park or around Říčany on natural obstacles. There are also several interesting locations in Prague..


We'll lend you a bike – because a mountain bike isn't suitable for Trial training and you could damage it, we'll lend you a bike and set it up for you.

Training is led by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, 10-time Czech Elite champion in mountain bike Trial and holder of Czech jumping records. He also did well in international races, where he was among the world's TOP 15 riders and won the UCI European Cup. He has been through many injuries and the now dead end of Biketrial, and through club training and teaching MTB and Trial to the public he has gained plenty of coaching experience that he can now pass on to you. If necessary, other leading Czech riders from our team (Marek Tryner or Lukáš Valný) will step in.


PRICE:

According to the individual course price list: https://bikeskills.cz/en/individual-courses


LOCATION:

The course takes place at Nupacká 112, Nupaky 251 01, in a barn converted into a Trial hall. So you can train regardless of weather and light conditions. The venue is accessible by car / bus. Parking is available nearby.

Mostly wooden obstacles on a concrete surface are available.

Location: by arrangement

SUITABLE FOR:

Men, women and children. Children only when accompanied by parents, on an individual basis. Ideal for beginners, amateur and professional riders.

EQUIPMENT:

– helmet pulled down over the crown of the head

– bike shoes without SPD


We'll adapt the date to your requirements!


CAPACITY, BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS:

Courses and camps have limited capacity. You can check availability in the header of the camp description (booked / total capacity), as well as the price. Your companions can attend, but we'll primarily focus on you and the other paying riders.

Bookings can be made using the form on this page or by e-mail to info@bikeskills.cz. Confirmation from us is required. We'll send you an invoice right away or, by arrangement, before the event (2–3 weeks). Payment must be made by the due date stated on the invoice.

Cancellation is possible for a fee of 50% of the total camp price 14 days before the event, or 90% of the total camp price 13 days or less before the event. Or by arrangement (injury, illness, force majeure).

By paying and attending the event, participants confirm that they take part at their own risk. The organiser is not responsible for loss of or damage to property.
